description: This file contains a TypeScript module that exports a constant string which embeds a Python script as a raw string. The embedded Python script handles sandboxed filesystem operations such as directory walking, file creation, removal, renaming, and executing commands with specific flags, intended for use within a larger application that manages sandboxed environment modifications.

methods.name: open_dir
methods.description: Opens a directory given a path, returning the file descriptor.

methods.name: walk_parent
methods.description: Traverses to a parent directory, optionally creating missing directories if enabled.

methods.name: create_temp_file
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in the specified directory with a unique name.

methods.name: fd_path
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path for a file descriptor, optionally appending a basename.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Runs a command with specified file descriptors passed.

methods.name: write_stdin_to_fd
methods.description: Reads from stdin and writes data to a specified file descriptor.

methods.name: run_write
methods.description: Handles write operations: setting up directories, creating temp files, writing data, and replacing target files.

methods.name: run_remove
methods.description: Removes files or directories, optionally force and recursive.

methods.name: run_rename
methods.description: Renames or moves files/directories between locations.
